summary: Increased bilateral perihilar and basal haze on current compared with a clearer, well-aerated prior.

findings.rationale: Prior shows clear, sharply defined lungs with sharp costophrenic angles. Current shows increased bilateral perihilar and lower-zone haze with less distinct vascular markings and a slightly less sharp right costophrenic angle. Differing support-line burden and technique between exams limit certainty.
